verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents ships built-in conversation analysis: success evaluation against custom criteria, structured data extraction, sentiment analysis across completed conversations, and meaning-based search of conversation history. Together these give in-product insights from the user's own conversation data. However, the docs never explicitly say these insights are AI-generated, and nothing shows the product proactively suggesting improvements or next actions. missing for 10: explicit evidence the analysis is AI/LLM-generated, proactive AI suggestions or recommendations derived from the data, insights over data beyond conversations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Success evaluation: Define custom criteria to assess conversation quality, goal achievement, and customer satisfaction
Sentiment analysis: Understand user sentiment across completed conversations
Data collection: Extract specific data points from conversations such as contact information, issue details, or any structured information
Searching conversations: Find messages by keyword or meaning across your conversation history.
